title: ArchitectureModel
description: Authoring contract for a project's compact high-level architecture map. Validates the YAML frontmatter of an architecture-model Markdown file. The map is intended to drive software-to-architecture drift analysis and the marble-style Drift surface; it is deliberately small and human-writable. Hard limit of ten elements per map. Storage lives with project evidence (watched project repository or workspace), never in the agent-taskboard source repo. See docs/architecture-model.md for the prose contract.

modelId.description: Stable kebab-case id for this architecture model. Drift reports reference it via architectureModel.modelId.

title.description: Human-readable model title. Shown above the marble diagram.

project.description: Project name as shown in the project organization layer. Matches DriftReport.project.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which this revision of the model was authored.

owner.description: Optional human owner of this model (name, handle, or role).

summary.description: One- or two-sentence description of what the model covers. Renders as the diagram's subtitle.

diagramHint.description: Optional layout hint for the marble surface. Free-form text the renderer may ignore (for example: 'two rows', 'group runtime elements right'). The marble layout is owned by the UI; this is a hint, not a coordinate.

elements.description: High-level architecture elements. Hard limit of ten keeps the map reviewable and forces the author to pick.

elementId.description: Stable kebab-case id, unique within this model. Drift reports key per-element scores by this id.

label.description: Short display label for the marble. One line.

expectedRole.description: What this element is supposed to own or do, in one or two sentences. The drift analyzer compares this against current code responsibility.

ownershipBoundary.description: Glob patterns or path prefixes that define which files belong to this element. Used by the analyzer to attribute source changes to one element. Example: 'backend/Services/Runner/**', 'frontend/src/app/protocol/**'.

guidelines.description: Important rules this element should follow. Free-form bullet phrases, not links. Example: 'No SQL'; 'One writer pattern'; 'Validates every append'.

allowedDependencies.description: Element ids (within this model) or external system names this element may depend on. The analyzer flags dependencies outside this set as drift.

sourceRefs.description: Docs, ADRs, folders, or other authoritative source references for this element's expected role. Repository-relative paths or fragment links (for example 'docs/architecture-decisions.md#adr-0024').

relevantTests.description: Tests or test directories whose green-state is evidence the element still works as intended. Example: 'backend.Tests/InMemoryStoreTests.cs', 'frontend/e2e/kanban-seven-lanes.spec.ts'.

relevantSchemas.description: JSON Schemas that define the data contracts owned or consumed by this element. Repository-relative paths such as 'docs/schemas/agent-message.schema.json'.

runtimeSignals.description: Stable runtime event names, log streams, metric names, or REST endpoints the analyzer can use to confirm the element's runtime behavior. Example: 'event:cycle-resume-failed', 'log:logs/meta/<project>/observations.jsonl', 'endpoint:/api/jobs/grouped'.

notes.description: Optional short authoring note. The Markdown body below the frontmatter is the preferred place for prose; this field is for one-line caveats that should travel with the structured record.
